html:
Step into the gentle rhythm of your own little café in Coffee Craze.

Serve coffee and small pastries to customers while slowly making the place your own by moving things around and changing decorations.

it’s not stressful at all, there’s no timer or anything, you can take your time and do whatever you feel like.

Gameplay:

  • Open the Coffee Shop

  • Serve your clients with their favorite drink or food

  • Collect the money 💰

  • Decorate your store with dozens of furniture!

  • Are you feeling good? Buy new machines to bring new types of clients!

This game has been made by Nikoffee during her internship at Cold Coffee Studio.
